description: This header file defines the interface for the hmac_wrapper class, which provides a wrapper around OpenSSL's HMAC functionality for computing HMACs. It manages context initialization, updating with message data, and final digest calculation, with handling for different OpenSSL versions.

classes.name: hmac_wrapper
classes.description: A utility class for computing HMACs using OpenSSL, abstracting version differences and managing context lifecycle.

methods.name: hmac_wrapper(const uint8_t *key, size_t key_length)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the HMAC context with the provided key.

methods.name: update(const uint8_t *message, size_t message_length)
methods.description: Updates the HMAC with additional message data.

methods.name: digest(uint8_t *digest, size_t digest_length)
methods.description: Completes the HMAC computation and outputs the digest.
